Author: Nori
Name: MasterBaiter
Punchline: Keeps your fishing bait and lures stocked, on its own.
Description:
Reads your GatherBuddy Reborn auto-gather list, works out which fishing bait and lures those fish need, and compares that against your inventory.

It shows what is missing, where to buy it and what it costs. It travels to the vendors on its own with vnavmesh and Lifestream, restocks at gil shops and scrip exchanges, plans a route across several vendors, rides to the Cosmic Exploration planets, and can fill the rest at the market board within a price per item and a total per run that you set.

Opens with /masterbaiter or the shorter /mbait.

Requires GatherBuddy Reborn, vnavmesh and Lifestream.
Changelog:
0.6.2
- The button says what it makes: Create "Big Fish" list in GatherBuddy.
- It also says, before you press it, that GatherBuddy has to be reloaded afterwards. That note used to appear only once the list was already written.

0.6.1
- A path that stops is no longer taken as an arrival. vnavmesh clears its waypoints whenever the navmesh reloads, which is right after every zone change, and that looked exactly like finishing the walk.
- A vendor whose height is guessed is placed with a bounded search instead of a floor search that looks down the whole column. That is what put the character a deck below the vendor in Tuliyollal.
- An approach spot is checked against the walkable ground before walking to it.
- The log names the path length and how far the walk ended from where it was sent.

0.6.0
- Fixed: gather lists were read from a folder named GatherBuddyReborn. A custom build is called whatever its author called it, and its lists live under that name — so the bait planning could be working from a folder nobody had written to in days.
- The folder is now found by its files, not its name, and Options shows which one, with leftover folders marked "not loaded".
- New: write a GatherBuddy list of every big fish still missing from your log. Same selection as its own Big Fish + Uncaught filters.
- Your other lists are copied through untouched and a timestamped backup is written first. Reload GatherBuddy afterwards — it only reads that file when it loads.

0.5.7
- New: Ragworm, Krill and Plump Worm stay in your bags. Ocean Fishing is not in the gather list, so Sort Bait Storage used to file them away as ballast.
- Off under Options if you do not sail.

0.5.6
- No more running into the aetheryte after a teleport. The path was being worked out before the game had put your character down, so it started from the map origin.
- An NPC standing a floor above you is reached. Their measured height was being replaced by a guessed one, and the character walked to the deck underneath.
- Six approach spots are six. Three of them used to come out identical, so the last attempts changed nothing.
- Walking into something is noticed after three seconds instead of five.

0.5.5
- The log now follows the whole run: every state change of every part, every window opening and closing, the zone, your currencies, free bag slots, the route plan, and which button you pressed.
- Transitions only, not frames — a whole route run is a few hundred lines. Switch it off under Debug if you would rather not.

0.5.4
- A currency you have never been seen holding no longer counts as none. Cosmic Exploration stops disappeared from the route for anyone who had not yet logged in there.
- The stock breakdown moved from the Bag column to Total, where it explains the number it belongs to.
- Three tooltips that were never visible: one overwritten by another, one missing entirely, two unreadable while their button was greyed out.

0.5.3
- The character lands before talking. Flying to a vendor ended above them, and from up there nobody answers.
- Sort Bait Storage no longer stops before it starts. An empty retainer list means the game has not handed one out yet, not that you have none.
- A retainer's bait is only noted while their bag is actually open — one retainer's stock was briefly written under the next one's name.
- New: pick the city for the summoning bell and for the market board, instead of always taking the nearest.
- The Debug tab is sorted into Look, Bait storage and Forget, and two buttons that shared one tooltip have their own again.

0.5.2
- A bait the market board had nothing listed for is left out of the next runs for three hours, instead of costing five seconds every time.
- Fetching stops once the gap in your bags is covered, rather than taking every stack of that bait.

0.5.1
- A stack larger than the gap in your bags is fetched too. The rule that kept it back guarded against a to-and-fro that no longer exists.

- Item moves are slow and bounded on purpose: they are packets, and a burst of refused ones costs a disconnect.

- Currency balances are remembered, because Cosmocredits are only readable inside Cosmic Exploration and read as zero everywhere else.

- The log says how long each walk took.
- Removed the old buying path that predates the purchase queue, along with nine other things nothing called any more.

0.4.1
